title: Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Simai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kohelet Rabbah 11:1, but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be as the statement is cited in Bereshit Rabbah 48:10: “Rabbi Elazar in the name of Rabbi Simai.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Bereshit Rabbah 48:10 fully writes Rabbi Elazar in Rabbi Simai’s name, supporting the contextual expansion of ר״א. Hyman proposes replacing filiation with this transmission.

The whole Torat Emet Kohelet Rabbah 11:1 scalar has Rabbi Elazar beRabbi Simai, while the whole selected Bereshit Rabbah 48:10 scalar has Rabbi Elazar in the name of Rabbi Simai. These support the local full titles while preserving the difference between filiation and transmission. Hyman calls the first reading a scribal error and says it should read like the second; that judgment remains his and does not repair the supplied Hebrew or admit a genealogy. The earlier mixed note remains verbatim.
